# AutoPlanet Corporation

> AutoPlanet Corporation is an AI-native engineering team that ships production-ready AI systems for enterprise. We build autonomous agents, custom LLMs, RAG pipelines, workflow automation, and full SaaS builds. 100% code ownership, fixed-price, 48-hour proposals.

AutoPlanet Corporation (APC) is an enterprise AI automation company that designs, builds, and deploys production-grade AI systems. We are not a consultancy that adopted AI — we were born from it. Every engagement ships with complete source code, model weights, and IP transferred to the client. No vendor lock-in, no recurring license fees.

## Core Offerings
- AI Agents (autonomous support, ops, outreach, enrichment)
- Custom LLM Development (fine-tuning, RAG, prompt architecture)
- AI SaaS Products (end-to-end builds with auth + billing)
- Workflow Automation (intelligent data pipelines)
- AI Integrations (CRM, ERP, Slack middleware)
- Mobile Apps (React Native, Flutter)
- Computer Vision & Predictive Analytics
- Enterprise Security (VPC deployment, red-teaming)

## Pricing Model
Fixed-price only. Three tiers: Quick Build (~₹29,000, 2 weeks), Full Product (₹89,000, 4-8 weeks), Ongoing Partner (₹45,000/month). 48-hour proposal guarantee or next sprint free.

## Key Stats
- 40+ AI systems shipped
- 99.9% uptime SLA
- 99.2% model accuracy baseline
- 100% code ownership
- 24/7 autonomous operation
- 3x avg ROI improvement

## Process
1. Free 30-min discovery call
2. 48-hour scoped proposal
3. 1-2 week build sprints with Friday demos
4. Deploy & hand-off with 30-90 day support

## Tech Stack
GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini, Llama 3, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Stripe, RAG frameworks, agentic frameworks.
